text:
### 3. Make Your First Deposit
- **Online Transfer:** Log in and select "Receive Money"
- **Branch Deposit:** Visit any FirstUK location
- **Standing Order:** Set up auto-transfers from another bank
name: Chunk 7/23

raw_entities.name: Online Transfer Deposit
raw_entities.description: Customer guidance on depositing funds via online banking by logging in and selecting the Receive Money option. This is the primary digital deposit method for new account holders.
context: Log in and select "Receive Money"
Online Transfer: Log in and select "Receive Money"

raw_entities.name: Branch Deposit
raw_entities.description: Customer guidance on depositing funds in person at any FirstUK branch location. This provides an alternative deposit method for customers who prefer face-to-face banking.
context: Visit any FirstUK location
Branch Deposit: Visit any FirstUK location

raw_entities.name: Standing Order Setup
raw_entities.description: Guidance on establishing a standing order to automatically transfer funds from another bank account to the FirstUK account. This enables recurring deposits without manual intervention.
context: Set up auto-transfers from another bank
Standing Order: Set up auto-transfers from another bank
